description: Realistic integration prompts that should trigger and exercise the moonpay-payments skill. Use with skill-evaluator / the skill-creator eval loop to benchmark with-skill vs baseline.

evals.name: onramp-nextjs-signed-buy
evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js store and want customers to buy ETH with a credit card right on my checkout page using MoonPay. The destination wallet comes from their connected wallet. Wire it up so the wallet address can't be tampered with, and so I only fulfill the order once the payment is actually confirmed.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Widget on-ramp (@moonpay/moonpay-js or @moonpay/moonpay-react with dynamic ssr:false for Next.js), sets walletAddress, signs the URL SERVER-SIDE with the secret key via HMAC-SHA256 over new URL(url).search (generateUrlForSigning + updateSignature, or scripts/sign-url.js), and treats the Moonpay-Signature-V2 webhook (transaction_updated/completed) — not onTransactionCompleted — as the source of truth for fulfillment.

evals.name: webhook-verify-express
evals.prompt: Add a MoonPay webhook endpoint to my Express app that marks an order paid only when the transaction is genuinely completed, and make sure nobody can spoof a fake 'completed' event.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the Moonpay-Signature-V2 header (t=...,s=...) as HMAC-SHA256(webhookKey, timestamp + '.' + RAW body) using the dashboard webhook key (not sk_), captures the raw body (express.raw), de-duplicates events (they can repeat / arrive out of order), and is idempotent. Ideally uses scripts/verify-webhook.js.

evals.name: offramp-react-native-cashout
evals.prompt: Our React Native app needs to let users cash out their USDC to a bank account via MoonPay. Walk me through the off-ramp flow, especially the part where we actually move the crypto.
evals.expected_output: Uses the off-ramp Widget (flow: 'sell') via @moonpay/react-native-moonpay-sdk, explains the sell flow, and crucially that the integrator's app SENDS the crypto on-chain to MoonPay's deposit address (onInitiateDeposit handler returning { depositId }) within 48h, plus signing and the sell_transaction_* webhooks.

evals.name: platform-frames-headless-applepay
evals.prompt: I want a fully custom, co-branded crypto buy screen with Apple Pay using MoonPay where I control the entire UI rather than embedding their widget. What's the right approach?
evals.expected_output: Recommends the Platform + Frames product (@moonpay/platform-sdk-web), not the Widget: server mints a session token (POST /platform/v1/sessions with X-Api-Key), createClient({sessionToken}), connect the customer, getQuote, then setupApplePay/setupBuy (headless) with the opaque quote signature, handling challenge events via setupChallenge and CSP/domain allowlisting.

evals.name: key-and-auth-confusion
evals.prompt: My MoonPay API call keeps returning 401. I'm calling https://api.moonpay.com/v3/currencies/eth/buy_quote and the Get customer endpoint with the same Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... header. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the non-uniform Widget API auth: quote/currencies/limits use the publishable key as the apiKey QUERY param, while Get customer / payment-method-config use Authorization: Api-Key sk_live_... (NOT Bearer, NOT X-Api-Key). Distinguishes this from the Platform API which uses X-Api-Key.
